difficulty_reason: The final generic-constituent exclusion depends on locating every relevant torsion class in the correct integral resolution maps, rather than only on characteristic-zero degeneration. Section3.2 transfers that analysis to the character-supported nearby-cycle graded pieces before the non-generic reduction argument applies; this newly retained integral analysis is the nonroutine obligation.
